quizTitle: Elections: Fun Facts and Global Trivia

questions.question: Which country was the first in the world to grant women the right to vote in 1893?
In the United States, how often are presidential elections held?
Which small European country has one of the highest voter turnouts in the world, often above 90%?
Which device or system allows voters to cast their votes electronically?
Which country is known for holding the world’s longest election process, lasting over a month?
In some countries, voters dip their finger in ink after voting. What is the purpose of this?
What term describes an election where no candidate wins a clear majority, leading to another round of voting?
In the UK, where do citizens go to cast their votes during an election?
Which country uses a unique system called 'compulsory voting', where citizens are legally required to vote?
What is the purpose of an election exit poll?
options: To predict results before the official count
questions.answer: To predict results before the official count

questions.question: Who can run for president in France — any citizen, or only those nominated by elected officials?
options: Only those nominated by 500 elected officials
questions.answer: Only those nominated by 500 elected officials
